# g_dp_box

> On-volume id: currently **`dt_box`** (`primitives/basic/dt_box.asm.ts`). This doc uses the family name `g_dp_box`; rename the part if you want the id to match.

**Purpose:** Parametric drill-pipe box-end connector with an enlarged collar, body tube, and internal thread bore, generated by full 360° revolution of a closed 2-D profile.

---

## Function

Models the box (female) end of a drill-pipe tool-joint. The collar provides the upset shoulder for make-up torque transfer; the reduced-diameter body transitions to a thin-walled tube; the inner bore step represents the thread relief zone where the pin thread engages.

---

## Composition

1. **Sketch (`n_9cchlv`)** — a 9-vertex closed 2-D polyline in the r–z plane, with one fillet at the collar-to-body step; 64 interpolation segments.
2. **Revolve (`r_revolve`, alias A)** — full 360° revolution of the sketch about the z-axis; 200 angular segments.

No Boolean CSG is applied; the solid is a single revolved body.

---

## Parameters

| param | meaning | default | units |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collar_od` | Outer diameter of the collar (upset) section | 6 | in |
| `collar_upset` | Radial setback from collar OD to the near-face radius at z ≈ 0 | 0.4 | in |
| `od_body` | Outer diameter of the body tube | 4.5 | in |
| `wall` | Wall thickness of the body tube (sets bore radius = od_body/2 − wall) | 0.55 | in |
| `length_collar` | Axial length of the collar section | 4 | in |
| `length_body` | Axial length of the body section (beyond the collar) | 1.5 | in |
| `fillet_bot` | Fillet radius at the collar-to-body OD step | 0.5 | in |

> The thread-relief shoulder station (the doc's `length_thd` ≈ 3) is currently baked into the sketch as literal z values (`3.011`, `2.877`) rather than a declared param.

---

## Drawing notes

**Z-down convention: z = 0 is the box face (top/lower z); z increases downhole.**

| z station | r (OD side) | r (bore side) | feature |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.01 | `collar_od/2 − collar_upset` | — | Near-face chamfer point |
| 0 | `collar_od/2` | — | Collar face |
| `length_collar` | `collar_od/2` → `od_body/2` | — | Fillet transition (radius = `fillet_bot`) |
| `length_collar + length_body` | `od_body/2` | `od_body/2 − wall` | Bottom of body; bore opens here |
| `3.011` | — | `od_body/2 − wall` | Thread relief shoulder (bore step) |

- The collar runs at full `collar_od` from z = 0 to `length_collar`.
- The body OD (`od_body`) is constant from `length_collar` to `length_collar + length_body`.
- The bore at `od_body/2 − wall` spans from `length_collar + length_body` (downhole end) back up to the relief shoulder.
- Above the relief (toward the box face) the profile closes back to full OD — this defines the thread bore relief region.
- A small 10-thou (z = 0.01) step at the collar face creates the upset shoulder face.
